item.title: Using ChatGPT to Write a Script for Generating Chinese Subtitles for Video Files
item.author: Author
item.description:
Using ChatGPT to Write a Script for Generating Chinese Subtitles for Video Files

Background

For some obscure movies or videos, it is hard to find Chinese subtitles even though they have a plot, so in these cases you have to add Chinese subtitles manually. But adding Chinese subtitles by hand is extremely time-consuming, especially for long videos. So I wanted to use ChatGPT to help me write a script that can automatically generate Chinese subtitles for video files.

item.title: Class Constructor TypeOrmCrudService Cannot Be Invoked Without 'New'
item.author: Author

Class Constructor TypeOrmCrudService Cannot Be Invoked Without ‘New’ Error

Cause

Recently I was developing a chatgpt gateway project using nestjs, with nestjsx-crud to speed up curd development, and I had the following code:

@Injectable()
export class ChatgptAccountService extends TypeOrmCrudService<ChatGPTAccount> {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(ChatGPTAccount)
    private readonly chatgptAccountRepository: Repository<ChatGPTAccount>,
  ) {
    super(chatgptAccountRepository);
  }

At runtime it threw the error:

1

Class Constructor TypeOrmCrudService Cannot Be Invoked Without 'New'

Solution

I looked it up online and found one here: For anyone stumbling over this issue: it's probably a tsconfig issue. Try bumping your target from es5 to es6.
